Archify is a Node.js rendering and validation system for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. Agents produce typed JSON IR; Archify deterministically compiles it into HTML/SVG. Current stable version: v2.16.0 . See Changelog . Project page · Scenario guide · Proof Lab Using Cursor? Open the agent-aware quick start for exact global and project commands. No repository is required: describe the system in any agent chat.

title: 巴克莱：AI 模型公司每赚 100 美元 约 35 至 40 美元流向三大云巨头

summary: Barclays reports that for every $100 in revenue AI model companies earn, $35–$40 flows to cloud providers AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud as inference computing fees. Cloud services capture $10–$20 in operating profit, representing 35–45% margins. AI labs' inference profit margins are projected to rise from low double digits in 2025 to 50–65% by 2026, with adjusted gross margins improving 30–50 percentage points year-over-year. However, intensifying competition and increased computing supply are expected to gradually reduce these margins.

This follows Anthropic's previous $1.5 billion copyright settlement with authors and publishers in September 2025, the largest of its kind in U.S. history.
